detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

KLOW

(BPC-157 / GHK-Cu / TB-500 / KPV)

Chemical Information:
  • BPC-157
    • Molecular Formula: C62H98N16O22
    • Molecular Weight: 1419.5 g/mol
    • Sequence: Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Asp-Ala-Gly-Leu-Val
  • GHK-Cu
    • Molecular Formula: C14H24CuN6O4
    • Molecular Weight: 403.9 g/mol. *)
    • *) Note: GHK-Cu may appear as ~340 Da (peptide only) or ~404 Da (copper complex) depending on MS conditions. The blue color confirms copper is present in the complex
    • Sequence: Gly-His-Lys (copper-bound tripeptide complex)
  • TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4)
    • Molecular Formula: C212H350N56O78S
    • Molecular Weight: 4963 g/mol
    • Sequence: Ac-Ser-Asp-Lys-Pro-Asp-Met-Ala-Glu-Ile-Glu-Lys-Phe-Asp-Lys-Ser-Lys-Leu-Lys-Lys-Thr-Glu-Thr-Gln-Glu-Lys-Asn-Pro-Leu-Pro-Ser-Lys-Glu-Thr-Ile-Glu-Gln-Glu-Lys-Gln-Ala-Gly-Glu-Ser
  • KPV
    • Molecular Formula: C16H30N4O4
    • Molecular Weight: 342.4 g/mol
    • Sequence: Lys-Pro-Val
  • Structure Class: Synthetic multi-peptide research blend
Product Description:

KLOW is a proprietary research peptide blend composed of BPC-157, GHK-Cu, TB-500, and KPV. Each component represents a distinct structural class of peptide, combined in lyophilized form for use in advanced laboratory studies. This blend is supplied exclusively for in vitro use and is intended for qualified research professionals.

Research Applications:

KLOW is utilized in controlled research protocols addressing topics such as:

  • Modeling of multi-peptide signaling interactions in in vitro systems
  • Evaluation of blend stability and compatibility under controlled experimental conditions
  • Analysis of peptide-associated signaling pathways in multi-component research models
  • Comparative studies of multi-component versus single-peptide experimental environments
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized material at −20°C (−4°F)
  • After reconstitution, store at 2–8°C (36–46°F) and use promptly
  • Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles
  • Maintain aseptic techniques during laboratory handling
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified for each peptide)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

KLOW is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
